profile.strategy_summary: Conservative value investing. Seeks financially disciplined companies with strong governance, healthy margins, and consistent shareholder returns.
profile.strategy_summary_zh: 保守价值投资。寻找财务纪律严明、治理健全、利润率健康且股东回报持续的企业。

profile.strategy_summary: Impact-focused ESG investing. Backs companies demonstrating genuine commitment to environmental sustainability, social responsibility, and governance quality.
profile.strategy_summary_zh: 影响力导向的ESG投资。支持在环境可持续性、社会责任和治理质量方面展现真正承诺的企业。

profile.strategy_summary: Aggressive growth investing. Backs companies that invest in innovation, expand into new markets, and pursue revenue growth over short-term profitability.
profile.strategy_summary_zh: 激进增长投资。支持那些投资创新、拓展新市场、以营业收入增长优先于短期盈利的企业。

scenario.description: You are the executive team of a mid-size consumer electronics company headquartered in North America. Your firm has a solid domestic presence with two established product lines, but the board is pushing for international expansion. Three global markets await — each with different customer preferences, regulatory environments, and competitive dynamics. Over 10 rounds (each representing one quarter), you must develop your technology platform, launch products, enter new markets, and build a sustainable global business. Your competitors are doing the same.
